title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet - 49-Inch Tall Solid Brass Towel Stand, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels organized and drying without drilling into your walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and fits beautifully in traditional bathrooms.

  • Maximize space with four pivoting arms that swing to separate towels and reduce clutter
  • Place it anywhere—freestanding design works in bathrooms where wall mounting isn’t ideal
  • Stay stable on the floor with a heavy solid brass base that helps prevent tipping
  • Protect floors and counters with a felt pad that helps prevent scratching
  • Choose the look you want—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives for enduring everyday bathroom use. Complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated look.

variants.title: Mediterranean Blue Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet - 49-Inch Tall Solid Brass Towel Stand, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
variants.body_html:
Keep towels organized and drying without drilling into your walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet is backed by a limited lifetime warranty and fits beautifully in traditional bathrooms — available in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stay stable on the floor with a heavy solid brass base that helps prevent tipping
  • Protect floors and counters with a felt pad that helps prevent scratching
  • Choose the look you want—available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes

Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives for enduring everyday bathroom use. Complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated look.

Specs
Product type: Freestanding towel stand / swing arm towel valet
Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in x 49 in x 10.5 in
Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
Mounting: Freestanding
Base: Heavy base; felt pad included to help prevent scratching
Assembly: Some assembly required
Includes: Towel stand
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
variants.meta_description: Freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet—49-inch solid brass towel stand with heavy base and felt pad. Traditional style, limited lifetime warranty.
